reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 21. Nay or No: 17. Not Voting: 1. Present or other: 1. stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

post.text:
We must pass the Major Richard Star Act. This would ensure our combat-injured veterans receive their FULL retirement pay, closing the “Wounded Warrior Tax” loophole that has adversely affected veterans and their families for far too long.

Our veterans who have taken care of us, deserve to be taken care of 'by' us - and I’m honored to vote for this bill on Veterans Day.
